when.description: cancels working orders and sells the whole position with a market order

any.description: OR: the event fires when any situation passes; the first passing situation (array order) wins
any.title: Any

to.description: id of another phase of the same list
to.title: To

stop.description: stop loss: the position is sold at market once a bar's low reaches the level

target.description: take profit: sold at market once a bar's high reaches the level (the stop is tested first)

action.description: cancel_pending: close the open stage (cancel unfilled entries, place no more); reduce: sell size_fraction of the position
action.title: Action

once.description: fire at most once per entry cycle
once.title: Once

when.description: take-position event: an entry cycle starts when it fires while active, flat, with nothing working

cancel.description: cancels this order while it is working (limit/stop only)

create.description: checked on every bar of the cycle while the order is not placed; when it fires the order is placed (it fills from the next bar). Absent: place it as soon as the cycle starts

offset_pct.description: limit/stop only: signed percent from the bar close at placement (limit buys: <= 0 = below)
offset_pct.title: Offset Pct

anyOf.description: Numeric expression, e.g. 'max(coalesce(stop_price, 0), close - 2 * atr(14))'. Arithmetic + - * /, parentheses, numbers. Functions: ema sma rsi bb_upper bb_middle bb_lower atr donchian_upper donchian_lower donchian_mid prev cross_above cross_below abs min max coalesce. Names: open high low close volume in_position is_long is_short position_size entry_price unrealized_pnl_pct bars_in_position stop_price target_price. Indicators and prices accept a last argument, a closed higher timeframe: ema(close, 20, "4h"), close("1d"). Evaluated on bar close; no value yet (not enough history, division by zero) means 'keep the previous value'.

rate.description: limit/stop only, instead of offset_pct: the order price as a formula, evaluated when the order is placed. A limit is capped at the bar close, a stop floored at it; <= 0 or no value means 'not this bar'
rate.title: Rate

rearm.description: after the order fills (or is cancelled) it may be placed again by its create event while the cycle lasts (v1 spawnMultipleOrders): a filled ladder level is re-placed
rearm.title: Rearm

anyOf.description: Numeric expression, e.g. 'max(coalesce(stop_price, 0), close - 2 * atr(14))'. Arithmetic + - * /, parentheses, numbers. Functions: ema sma rsi bb_upper bb_middle bb_lower atr donchian_upper donchian_lower donchian_mid prev cross_above cross_below abs min max coalesce. Names: open high low close volume in_position is_long is_short position_size entry_price unrealized_pnl_pct bars_in_position stop_price target_price. Indicators and prices accept a last argument, a closed higher timeframe: ema(close, 20, "4h"), close("1d"). Evaluated on bar close; no value yet (not enough history, division by zero) means 'keep the previous value'.

size.description: instead of size_fraction: a formula giving the fraction of equity, evaluated when the order is placed. Clamped to what is left of 100% of equity; <= 0 or no value means 'place nothing this bar'
size.title: Size

size_fraction.description: fixed fraction of account equity committed by this order
size_fraction.title: Size Fraction

stop_loss_pct.description: after this order fills, stop-sell at fill price x (1 - pct/100)
stop_loss_pct.title: Stop Loss Pct

take_profit_pct.description: after this order fills, sell it at fill price x (1 + pct/100)
take_profit_pct.title: Take Profit Pct

goto.description: move-to-phase events, in order; the first that fires wins
goto.title: Goto

id.description: unique within its stop or target
id.title: Id

level.description: the stop (or target) price while this phase is current
level.title: Level

next.description: moves to the next phase of the list (checked first)

phases.description: ordered; phase 1 is current when the position opens
phases.title: Phases

all.description: AND: every condition must be true for the situation to pass

items.description: Boolean expression, e.g. 'cross_above(ema(close, 12), ema(close, 26)) and rsi(close, 14) < 70'. Functions: ema sma rsi bb_upper bb_middle bb_lower atr donchian_upper donchian_lower donchian_mid prev cross_above cross_below abs min max coalesce. Names: open high low close volume in_position is_long is_short position_size entry_price unrealized_pnl_pct bars_in_position stop_price target_price. Indicators and prices accept a last argument, a closed higher timeframe: ema(close, 20, "4h"), close("1d").

all.title: All

name.description: audit label recorded when this situation fires
name.title: Name

off.description: deactivates (no new entries; working entries cancelled; a held position stays)

on.description: activates the strategy when it fires

schema_version.description: 2; documents of schema 1 must be migrated
schema_version.title: Schema Version
